property_summary: After two consecutive play() calls where only the second wins (random=0), the reference C pays out the pot accumulated from both calls (20 - fee = 19), then sets pot=0, while the buggy version only pays out the pot from the first call (10 - fee = 9) because pot never increased on the second call, so the final pot after second play is 1 (the leftover fee from the first win that was never added).
change_summary: Replace 'pot += msg.value;' with 'pot += 0;' so that pot does not increase on any play call.
